name: Northstar

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Reverb: Bu şampiyonun vuruşları, verilen hasara dayalı ek fiziksel hasar patlaması verir.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Hasar efektli şampiyonlar (yakma, şok, rupture vb.) en kolay yol. Güç kontrolü olanlar da iyi. E2'si bloğu çok yer, onu E1'de tutmak tavsiye edilir.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Aerodynamic
Whenever Northstar would gain Momentum, gain a +[124.95 - 6,416.67] Physical Resistance Passive for 6 seconds. Duration is increased by +3 seconds per Momentum. Max stacks: 1.
While a Physical Resistance effect is active, gain a Reinforce Passive, and incoming hits have [5 - 60]% reduced Block Penetration.

abilitySections.title: Speed Burst
content: Speed Burst starts the fight on cooldown for 24 seconds.

When the cooldown expires, activating a Special Attack during or after a Dash, Dash Attack, or after Punishing a Heavy or Special Attack activates Speed Burst for 12 seconds. Then it goes on cooldown again.
While Speed Burst is active, Northstar's Special Attack costs are reduced by 25%.
Speed Burst is paused while Northstar is using a Dash, Medium Attack, Striker, or during either Champion's Special Attacks.
As a Defender, Speed Burst activates immediately when the cooldown expires.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Light Attack Hits have a 30% to 10% chance to grant a Reverb Charge, scaling down with how many Charges he has.
Medium Attack Hits cause the cooldown for Speed Burst to briefly expire faster.
Against Skill Champions, the first hit of the second Medium Attack inflicts or refreshes a non-stacking Armor Break Debuff, lowering Armor Rating by [239.13] for 12 seconds.
While that Armor Break is active, the Opponent's Critical Resistance is lowered by 80%. If it is Purified, Northstar gains 1 Reverb Charge.

abilitySections.title: Momentum
content: Activating a Special Attack grants 1 indefinite Momentum per level of the Special Attack. When a Skill Opponent Evades, gain 1 Momentum.
The cooldown for Speed Burst is reduced by 3 seconds per Momentum.
As an Attacker with at least…
2 Momentum: Become Passively Unstoppable while performing a Dash or Dash Attack.
6 Momentum: If the first or second hits of a Special Attack hit the Opponent's Block, become Passively Unblockable for 0.75 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: On activation, 100% chance to gain a 12% Prowess Buff per Momentum for 10 seconds. Max stacks: 30.
All Special Attack hits have a +5% chance per Momentum to grant an additional Prowess.
All Special Attack hits gain +[1,178.57] Critical Rating during Speed Burst.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a Slow Passive for 10 seconds. Duration is increased by +4 seconds per Momentum.
Each hit has a 15% chance to pause personal Prowess and Reverb effects for 2 seconds. These pauses can stack, and expire one at a time.
Independently, if the hit was Critical, 100% chance to grant an additional pause.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit converts one Reverb Charge into a 12% Reverb Passive for 14 seconds. Max stacks: 25.
If the hit was Critical, gain 2 Reverb Passives instead.
Independently, if Speed Burst is active, converting a Reverb Charge has a 20% chance to grant an additional Reverb.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain 8 Reverb Charges.
Once per fight, Northstar's chance to trigger Prowess, Reverb, Reverb Charges, and pause effects is permanently increased by 200%.
